parsed.explanation: The decisive feature is an express criminal statute (Art. 521) punishing 'men disguising themselves as women' with up to six years, which a regional review says is applied both de facto and explicitly, targeting trans women. That is a known, presentation-triggered criminal exposure, not a dead letter. It is reinforced by documented police arrests of LGBT people, prosecutor-ordered anal examinations (a severe but dated 2012-era practice), assembly bans, and rising trans-targeted hostility in the capital. Offsetting: Article 534 has been judicially narrowed (2009–2023), courts froze the 2022 gatherings ban, and no current prosecution rate against trans visitors is documented. Border/facility/custody treatment of visitors is simply unrecorded, which is an open question, not proof of safety. Net: serious state-level exposure with thin, dated enforcement evidence against travellers — high risk, above the 0.25 tier but well below documented active sweeps and convictions.
